decisions.reason: The offshore unit was publicly set up as a dedicated business unit and flagship tied to the firm's announced move into offshore renewables, so management would persist and attribute any weak results to the temporary pandemic and oil-and-gas downturn.
Crew and corporate travel management sits directly on the firm's core crewing business and costs little to maintain, so there is little pressure to abandon it despite the lack of recent visibility.

The online vessel portal was presented as a flagship of the firm's digital, customer-proximity direction, and having committed to it publicly, management would keep investing rather than admit the earlier decision was wrong.

The performance app supports the announced goal of safer, cleaner shipping, but it is less visibly committed and may be folded into the portal, so its drop risk is moderate while keeping it remains the likely choice.
